# PortAI

> AI financial news bias checker and professional portfolio tracker for retail investors. Real-time tracking of stocks, ETFs and crypto, paired with AI sentiment and bias detection across major financial outlets.

PortAI helps retail investors cut through biased financial reporting. The platform combines a multi-asset watchlist (stocks, ETFs, crypto) with AI-powered fact-checking, trust scoring of news sources, and a live S&P 500 heatmap. Pro tier unlocks deeper bias reports and AI market analysis.
